ruleSummaries.description: File identifiers shall be defined by the ID entry in a PDF file’s trailer dictionary

checks.errorMessage: Missing or empty ID in the document trailer

ruleSummaries.description: The PDF/A version and conformance level of a file shall be specified using the PDF/A Identification extension schema. The PDF/A Identification schema defined in Table 2 uses the namespace URI "http://www.aiim.org/pdfa/ns/id/"

checks.errorMessage: The document metadata stream doesn't contain PDF/A Identification Schema

ruleSummaries.description: A content stream's named resources shall be defined by a resource dictionary, which shall enumerate the named resources needed by the operators in the content stream and the names by which they can be referred to

checks.errorMessage: A content stream references named resource(s) F2 not defined by a resource dictionary

ruleSummaries.description: If a document information dictionary is present, it shall only contain a ModDate entry

checks.errorMessage: Document information dictionary is present and contains CreationDate,Keywords,Producer,GTS_PDFXVersion,Author,Title,GTS_PDFXConformance,Creator,ModDate,Trapped,Subject key(s), but allowed only ModDate

ruleSummaries.description: The Info key shall not be present in the trailer dictionary of PDF/A-4 conforming files unless there exists a PieceInfo entry in the document catalog dictionary

checks.errorMessage: The Info key present in the trailer dictionary, but PieceInfo entry does not present in the document catalog dictionary

validationResult.statement: PDF file is not compliant with Validation Profile requirements.
